description: This file defines an interface for Anthropic's messages API, including asynchronous and synchronous functions to call the API with various parameters, and imports external modules and handlers related to Anthropic message processing.

methods.name: acreate
methods.description: Asynchronous function to call Anthropic's messages API with various parameters, returning a response or an async iterator.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Synchronous or coroutine-compatible function to call Anthropic's messages API with various parameters, returning a response, an async iterator, or a coroutine.
